title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.30702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. translated_title: 一个具有学习式前沿选择的智能体逆生物合成框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型正日益被用作多步骤逆合成的智能体，这引出了一个重要问题：其搜索策略在独立于底层反应模型的情况下究竟贡献了多少。我们在生物学场景中通过基于规则的逆生物合成来研究这一问题：一个确定性的生化引擎为每种方法生成完全相同的经过验证的转化步骤，搜索终止于大肠杆菌底盘可利用代谢物的合成路线，而策略仅负责选择下一步要扩展的前沿分子。经过提示工程和LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B策略使用严格的选择式接口。微调后的策略在LASER基准上10次扩展时达到65±1%的解决率，而MCTS为59%；在200次扩展时，LASER上达到78±1%对75%，RetroPath RL Golden基准上达到88±3%对80%，BioNavi-NP基准上达到63±2%对45%。微调还持续优于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个通过确定性生化引擎将反应模型与搜索策略解耦的智能体逆生物合成框架，证明LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B前沿选择策略在LASER、RetroPath RL Golden和BioNavi-NP等多个基准上显著优于MCTS等传统搜索方法。
